question: If one of the options of a villainous choice is to sacrifice a creature and I control no creatures, can I still choose that option?

expected.shortAnswer: Yes: a player facing a villainous choice can always choose either option, even if an option is impossible.
expected.answer: A player facing a villainous choice can always choose either option, even if one or both of the options are impossible. For example, if one of the options is to sacrifice a creature, a player who controls no creatures can still choose that option.
